test_title: PYST 33: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 23 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined word.

He took the __right__ decision at that time.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **Something which is correct**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"right"** in the given sentence means something that is correct or appropriate in a particular context. (सही / उचित)
 
 
• **English Meaning:** Conforming to facts or truth; morally good, justified, or acceptable.
 
• **Hindi Meaning:** सही या उचित
 
• **Example:** It was the right decision to help the needy during the difficult times.
 
 
• In this context, the sentence implies that the person made the correct or appropriate decision based on the situation.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Something which is correct**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: Someone’s liberty and freedom** (किसी की स्वतंत्रता और आज़ादी)
 
 
• **Explanation:** Refers to the rights or freedoms a person is entitled to.
 
• **Example:** Everyone has the right to freedom of speech.
 
 

 
• **Option 3: Something which is invalid** (कुछ जो अमान्य है)
 
 
• **Explanation:** Refers to something that is not legally or logically valid.
 
• **Example:** The contract was declared invalid by the court.
 
 

 
• **Option 4: A particular direction** (एक विशेष दिशा)
 
 
• **Explanation:** Refers to the direction that is opposite of left.
 
• **Example:** Turn right at the next intersection to reach the park.
